2. Lookup the "beta-testers" list:

lookup_list(list_name=list_name)
```

3. Preview the send to ensure the email will be sent to the correct recipients:
```

preview_send(list_name=list_name, subject=subject)
```

4. Since the user has reviewed the email and wants to proceed without asking for confirmation, I will send the email using the provided credential:
```

send_email(list_name=list_name, subject=subject, body=body, credential=credential)
```

5. Once the email has been sent, I will finish the task with a summary:
```
summary = "Sent the weekend maintenance email to the beta-testers."
finish(summary=summary)
```
